svg.title: SGD schedules with a shared five-update warmup

cc:Work.dc:title: SGD schedules with a shared five-update warmup
cc:Work.dc:description: Scalar quadratic with unit noise variance and unit initial second moment. All four schedules share five warmup updates and a common peak; total budget is 100 updates. The optimal tail is conditional on the fixed warmup, compared with linear, cosine, and constant tails at the same peak. All axes are linear. The t=100 boundary is not an applied update. Losses include warmup and are exact recurrences, not sampled training data.
